name: California Rotational Plastics
old_description: CRP believes that our excellence in manufacturing combined with our superior customer service will make us your choice supplier when rotational molding is required.
about:
California Rotational Plastics, based in Oxnard, California, was established in 1994 as a veteran-owned and operated business producing custom rotationally molded products. The company began with a focus on rotational molding and has since expanded its capabilities.

The company specializes in rotational molding using materials such as LLDPE, HDPE, polypropylene, cross-linked polyethylene, plastisol, and TPU. Its capabilities include mold design and tooling (cast aluminum, fabricated steel and stainless steel, CNC-machined molds), secondary cooling and trimming fixtures, in-house mold maintenance, leak and pressure testing, partial to full product assembly, in-mold and post-mold graphics, mold-in inserts, UL capabilities, order fulfillment, and a formal quality control program for each product.

CRP serves the marine, medical, construction, irrigation, and aftermarket automotive industries, delivering custom parts for applications ranging from fluid handling to structural components.

The company emphasizes its excellence in manufacturing combined with superior customer service, backed by over 35 years of industry experience and a hands-on quality inspection process.
